requirements.text: The system shall ensure compliance with data protection regulations when handling student attendance data.
The system shall maintain historical attendance data for a minimum of three years to comply with educational regulations.
The system shall allow students to dispute attendance records through a formal process within 10 days of marking.
The system shall implement role-based access control to restrict data access based on a unified model.
The system shall ensure that all student attendance data is encrypted at rest and in transit.
The system shall maintain an audit log of all access and modifications to attendance records while anonymizing sensitive information.
The system shall provide a mechanism for users to report unauthorized access or data breaches.
The system shall notify students of their attendance status via email or app notification within 24 hours of a class.
The system shall utilize energy-efficient practices in the logging mechanism and cloud storage solutions.
The system shall implement load balancing strategies that ensure both energy efficiency and resource optimization.
The system shall provide secure authentication of users to prevent unauthorized access to attendance data.
The system shall provide real-time data synchronization to maintain accurate attendance records across multiple classes.
The system shall generate attendance reports within 5 seconds for up to 1000 students.
The system shall allow students to view their attendance records with a response time of under 3 seconds.
The system shall ensure automated alerts for discrepancies in attendance reporting to ensure data accuracy.
The system shall undergo regular security audits to identify and mitigate potential vulnerabilities.
